name: const unsafe fn from_mut_ptr_range < 'a , T > (range : Range < * mut T >) -> & 'a mut [T]
rule: For safety, range.start must be valid and properly aligned for T and point to the first element of the slice.
api: const unsafe fn from_mut_ptr_range < 'a , T > (range : core::ops::range::Range < * mut T >) -> & 'a mut [T]
expression: The requirement is not expressible in the supplied grammar: `range.start` is modeled as opaque `Idx`, with no pointee view or pointer-address observation. Its `$mem` describes only the pointer slot, so it cannot establish pointee validity, alignment for `T`, or first-element identity.
